name: Terminal Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Terminal Rendering Pipeline — ASCII/ANSI Volume Rendering
definition: Renders the scene to a terminal buffer by iterating over pixels, mapping them to NDC, casting rays, and applying ASCII/ANSI styling based on depth and lighting.
summary: The Terminal Rendering Pipeline renders 3D scenes to text buffers by raymarching and applying ANSI codes, distinguished by explicitly accounting for character aspect ratio.
